_readme: Template. Copy to ~/.nhi1/hooks.local.json and edit THERE (the file name is from before 2026-11-16, when a hook sent uses; there is no hook any more). The real file is local-only: never commit it, never put it in server code. No file = no local deny list (the board's own address rules still apply).
_send: false = nothing leaves this machine through the reference client (uses and talks), whoever asks.
_deny: Local deny-list. Checked before anything leaves the machine. Glob * allowed. rules: localhost, private-ip, query, userinfo. hostExceptions win over hosts. A talk is also checked on its text: a deny-listed host, a URL caught by rules / hosts / urlPrefixes, or a keyword (case-insensitive) keeps the whole talk here.
_wall: Reading the wall (node aua.mjs wall): by default the reader is a `claude -p` call on your Claude Code command-line login; an API key in the environment is never used. true = use your own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (with --bare). Only this file can turn it on.
_servers: Optional: names for addresses, so deny.servers can match a use's address by server name.
